subject: System Design
title: What Is a Database
description: A quick win: understand What Is a Database.

hook.text: Every app you use — Instagram, Uber, Spotify — stores data somewhere. That somewhere is a database.

buildup.text: A database is an organized collection of data that can be efficiently stored, retrieved, and updated.

discovery.text: Databases use data structures like B-trees, hash tables, and LSM trees to make lookups fast.

twist.text: Not all databases are equal. Some are fast at reads, others at writes. None is great at everything.

climax.text: Choosing the right database is one of the most consequential decisions in system design.

punchline.text: The database choice shapes your entire system.

quiz.question: What is a database?
options: An organized collection of data for efficient storage and retrieval
